notes.title: First new DLC chapter The Lost Depths announced!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/63362e6a492c3f960ae13fca77c92d0c4ae454df.png

Explore the depths of the lost city of Atlantis and rebuild an ancient artefact.

Coming Soon to Steam - Venture deeper into the mystery of Infinite Inside with The Lost Depths, the first new DLC chapter that delves into the influence of the Plinth on ancient mythology. A new Plinth appears, sending you on a journey to rebuild a crucial artefact and deliver it to the lost civilisation of Atlantis.

[previewyoutube=dSSiITscZ_0;full][/previewyoutube]
A Unique Adventure

Discover a newly designed level inspired by Atlantis, featuring ethereal underwater environments, expanded game mechanics, and fresh puzzles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/c670a6520c152a185c2aca2ae1c23c500eb771ef.png
Introducing the Challenge Room

Prove your skill to the Plinth in a timed challenge, solving a vital puzzle before the room closes in. Complete this trial to gain the Plinth’s trust in delivering the artefact.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/8e6f47ab2658e2c4acea2d4e8a243f0b160c4cc3.png

Replayable Challenges

Once unlocked, revisit the Challenge Room with other keys from the game, offering new ways to test yourself and master the puzzles. Compete for the fastest solve time and top the global leaderboard.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/1e466a18f854b39ce1904dcb7577bc37a4757cae.png

Wishlist Now!

notes.title: Infinite Inside Patch 1 - Visual Quality Update Released
notes.content:
Thank you for the fantastic feedback on the release of Infinite Inside. We are thrilled to announce the release of the first patch for Infinite Inside! 

Check out the details below!

 Enhanced Visuals: Higher resolution on PCVR.
 Upgraded Lighting: Real-time shadows and improved lighting on PCVR.
 New Save System: More frequent saving across all platforms.
 Bug Fixes & Improvements: Various issues resolved across all platforms.

We can't wait for you to dive in and experience the latest updates!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/cb6ab532812e3a629bed0e26b9c2e9ad266c3190.jpg

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content: Added Mid Chapter Saves (the game saves collected puzzle pieces and creates checkpoints when you solve a puzzle/insert it into the plinth), Improved resolution and lighting/shadows as well as several bug fixes

It's been a long journey for the team and we couldn't be more excited to finally be releasing the full experience to the world. If you're entering the impossible for the first time, here's everything you need to know about the game.

What is Infinite Inside?

Explore an enchanting and mysterious world, collect shards, solve intricate puzzles, and assemble keys to unlock the mysteries of a secret society.

When the enigmatic ancient artifact known as the 'Plinth' mysteriously materialises in your home, it opens a portal to a tranquil, dream-like world, filled with impossible architecture and hidden secrets waiting to be discovered. Guided by the echoes of past explorers, you will collect shards, solve three-dimensional puzzles, and assemble keys to unlock the mysteries of a secret society committed to maintaining the balance of Order and Chaos. 

Can you solve the puzzles and reveal the truth about the society, the legacy of the Plinth, and ultimately, your own place in this mystical world?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/3f9187c5597e4282ab4a53f5fd88d5774babbff0.png

What To Expect

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/7d89816ef18bb635baa9d4c38324b137e0e5df24.png
Escape into five peaceful and soothing labyrinths filled with mysteries.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/01167233e817e1be3d506f39672ad2c50d4d943f.png
Engage with a deep and captivating story embedded in the world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/07d37871cda11b978b5798dfe544a4838f997707.png
Tackle mind-bending geometric puzzles at your own pace with intuitive controls.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/7086b2a1dea63821dccc5b5aad1cafd72d49731a.png
Immerse yourself in rich, captivating audio and music, deepening your connection with the world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/61d478b959ca0fa946b93e93c2a0d024fb8c5fdf.png

What Others Have Been Saying

Reviews have begun to roll out for Infinite Inside and the response has been fantastic! The game has been called “innovative”, “atmospheric”, and “gorgeous” by the leading XR news outlets. Check out the full reviews below:
